name: Arcane Library
description: A repository of magical knowledge. Unlocks the card library browser, researches cards the guild has not yet found, and supplies Insight at the parley table.

tiers.description: A modest collection. Unlocks the Card Library browser.
Research opens: commission an undiscovered card from the Card Library (2 at once, 3 lunations each). +1 Insight card in every parley deck.

3 commissions at once, and 2 Insight cards per parley. And a doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Forbidden Archives: research takes 2 lunations. Or the Chancery: every parley opens with your school's card in hand and every Lore term's valuation already read.

doctrines.name: The Forbidden Archives
doctrines.description: The deck is the product. Commissioned research delivers in 2 lunations instead of 3, so the Library becomes the guild's main card faucet.

doctrines.name: The Chancery
doctrines.description: The Library feeds the table. Every parley opens with your school's sweeping card in hand, and every Lore term's valuation starts read.
